verdict.rationale: Thoropass shows control/action-item ownership (owners, status, milestones) and access-review reminders tied to policy timelines, which cover some 'owner + due date + reminder' elements, but there is no explicit documentation of a distinct workflow for manual (non-automatable) evidence artifacts with expiry/renewal tracking. Missing for 10: explicit manual-evidence expiry dates, renewal reminder cadence tied to individual evidence items, and confirmation that this applies specifically to non-automated evidence rather than controls/action items generally.
